q: 给我发段晨检上线里程碑的总结
reply: Here's the morning check (晨检) launch milestones summary:

**Sep timeline:**
iOS originally targeted Sep 10 → flashback crash, pushed to Sep 18 → iOS review rejection → pushed again to Sep 25. Big screen ads test in Jing'an (3 buildings, 17k spent) got only 63 scans in half a day — killed it, shifted budget to online at 50k.

**Sep 25 launch:**
iOS went live. DAU day 1 hit 200, stabilized at 150-200. Mia's logo went through 3 rounds then back to v1. Dawei's channel expansion started.

**Oct milestones:**
DAU peaked at 2100 on Oct 22. Day-7 retention 38% (above Sequoia's 2000 threshold). Android slipped from mid-Oct → end Oct → now mid-Nov. Mia delivered new UI scheme. Cash runway 6M after BlueRun second tranche.

**Key learnings:**
offline ads didn't work, online spend drove DAU better. iOS delayed 15 days total due to bugs + review. Android still in progress.
